name: io.github.davidb3l/hayvenhurst
title: Hayvenhurst
description: Code graph of the Sothis suite. Claude Code stdio MCP; Windows, macOS, Linux.

dev.hayvenhurst.suite: Sothis suite — Sirius Forester (foreman), Hayvenhurst (code graph), Ametrite (board), Catryna Wikinelli (docs), PingMyBell (the bell)
dev.hayvenhurst.role: live code graph — precise context slices and affected-test selection
clients: any MCP client that speaks stdio JSON-RPC
dev.hayvenhurst.install: Prebuilt binaries on GitHub Releases: hayvenhurst-<version>-<platform>.tar.gz, sha256-verified by plugin/scripts/install-hayven.sh (or install-hayven.ps1). Claude Code plugin: `claude plugin marketplace add Davidb3l/Sirius-Forester` then `claude plugin install hayvenhurst@sirius-forester` and `/hayvenhurst:install-binary`. Then: claude mcp add hayvenhurst -- hayven mcp
dev.hayvenhurst.projectScopeConfig: A repo-root .mcp.json with { "mcpServers": { "hayvenhurst": { "command": "hayven", "args": ["mcp"] } } } makes the server auto-discoverable to any agent that opens the repo.
dev.hayvenhurst.requires: a .hayven/ index in (or above) the working directory — create one with `hayven init`; the server is daemonless, read-only and stateless
